blocks.text: NEW YORK— The New York Knicks said Thursday they are pausing ticket sales after a mistake caused them to be listed for amounts that were too high. The NBA champions put individual game tickets for the 2026-27 season on sale this week. The get-in price for the Oct. 20 season opener against Philadelphia was more than $1,000. READ: Knicks’ championship run will be remembered in NBA history “We are pausing Knicks individual ticket sales due to a mistake in our pricing.
